events.label: Наука
entries: 1858 – Charles Darwin receives a paper from Alfred Russel Wallace that includes nearly identical conclusions about evolution as Darwin's own, prompting Darwin to publish his theory.
1859 – First ascent of Aletschhorn, second summit of the Bernese Alps.
1983 – Space Shuttle program: STS-7, Astronaut Sally Ride becomes the first American woman in space.
2006 – The first Kazakh space satellite, KazSat-1 is launched.
2009 – The Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO), a NASA robotic spacecraft is launched.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1958 – Benjamin Britten's one-act opera Noye's Fludde premiered at the Aldeburgh Festival.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1908 – The University of the Philippines is established.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1928 – Aviator Amelia Earhart becomes the first woman to fly in an aircraft across the Atlantic Ocean (she is a passenger; Wilmer Stultz is the pilot and Lou Gordon the mechanic).
